# CategoryField

## Summary

CategoryField is the guest-relationship enum used across the planner — a `StringField` enum whose options come from `GUEST_CATEGORIES` in `../utils/index`: Bride's Family, Groom's Family, Close Friend, Friends, College, Colleagues, and Others. Each option carries a swatch color (via `categoryColor`) that drives the colored dots on the guest rail, seat markers, and fitted views, and a display label (via `categoryLabel`). The AI seat-arranger skill also reads this category to keep related parties together.

## Import

```js
import { CategoryField } from '../guest';
```

## Usage as a Field

```ts
@field category = contains(CategoryField);
```

## Template Usage

```handlebars
{{categoryLabel @model.category}}
```

Pair with `categoryColor` from `../utils/index` for the category's swatch color.
